label: Structured shared-IO feature process - production59 - stateless numbered layers - K1 2x1s input x 59 - K2 2x1s embedding density - layer 8 causal self-attention Q/K/V/O256 anchors - realized feature state encoded by shared layer 1 as stop-gradient Q256 - NF256 derives 16 K256 Gaussian component offsets and scalar mixture-value logits - fixed sigma 4 normalized mixture NLL - W256 M128 P128 F128 PF256 NF256 - 256k clean - batch 10240 train/evaluation - no regularization - EMA 4

layer8Attention.causality: output step s attends only to generated NF states <=s

featureEmbeddingDensity.keySource: current NF state offsets around the causal layer-8 expected-embedding anchor
featureEmbeddingDensity.valueSource: current NF state scalar logits normalized across components
featureEmbeddingDensity.normalization: softmax mixture values and exact isotropic Gaussian component normalizers

architecture.numberedLayerSharing: each parenthesized numbered layer is one exact shared stateless GNGLU reused at every matching block; no layer carries private recurrent memory
architecture.densityState: shared layer 7 maps PF to NF; causal layer 8 maps the generated NF prefix to a W anchor; the separate density attention derives sixteen K offsets and mixture-value logits from NF and evaluates the shared-layer-1 encoding of each realized future production59 feature state
architecture.pointDecoder: layer 2 is retained only for architectural compatibility; the training objective does not decode or supervise a deterministic feature point

loss.description: mean exact normalized Gaussian-mixture negative log likelihood of both realized future production59 states after shared-layer-1 encoding; no feature-space MSE auxiliary loss

sampling.description: the exact production59 dense chronological nonzero-target population with two observed rows and two realized future rows per origin
sampling.comparisonControl: same K1/K2, latent widths, data population, optimizer, examples, and EMA as the stateless two-step attention model; deterministic MSE supervision is replaced by embedding-density NLL

evaluation.headline: realized layer-1 feature-embedding negative log likelihood
evaluation.pointMetrics: not reported because this experiment defines only a normalized embedding density and no feature-space expectation decoder

alignment.input: two consecutive production59 rows ending at each control origin
alignment.target: the complete chronological production59 rows at origin+1 and origin+2, encoded by the exact shared layer 1
alignment.causality: step-s NF and its causal layer-8 anchor use no generated NF state after s; target embeddings are used only by the likelihood evaluator
alignment.antiCollapse: the target-side shared-layer-1 query is stop-gradient; layer 1 remains trained through the causal input path
alignment.normalization: attention values are softmax mixture masses and every key is a fixed-scale normalized Gaussian component, so the reported score includes a finite partition function
